dedupe_keys.name: brazil mining dams register anm barragens de mineracao sigbm

description: The national register of tailings and other mining dams in Brazil, from the SIGBM dam safety system of the national mining agency. The dados.gov.br page says the dataset lists the mining dams registered in SIGBM, that it is published under a Creative Commons Attribution licence as CSV and ODS files, updated daily, with the file changed on 25 September 2026, and that it is maintained by the ANM superintendence for dams and piles; the public SIGBM site shows the same dams, and Base dos Dados mirrors the table. The data are free. Coverage is Brazil. Caveats: fields depend on owner declarations, and version 2023.11 of the schema is noted on the page. For simulation it gives every mining dam with its risk and damage potential, for modelling tailings dam failures that cut rivers, rail and water supply, as at Mariana and Brumadinho. A related catalogue record is the Feijao Dam I failure expert panel case study.
